area: Viridian City (pond-side park and the north-west grove)
_doc: Not in FireRed/LeafGreen — ours, the same woodland life Pallet Town's groves roll. The pond-side park's bushes and the cut-gated grove are the town's two bug habitats, so both roll the bugs, with the odd Pidgey in the branches. mode: visible (they roam, they never ambush); levels sit at Route 1's (Pidgey 2-5, Rattata 2-4), which is the next route north.
